dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, smooth U-shape curvature on the posterior margin.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness at the lateral flanks, narrowing toward the central midline.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Defined gap visible between the two dark semicircular pinnae across the cranial vertex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent brownish-yellow discoloration and irregular fur texture/staining across the lower back and rump regions.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal band features a deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch on its anterior (cranial) border, creating a bi-lobed or heart-shaped appearance from a posterior view.
